pattern_explanation: Both languages borrowed these words from the same international sources, so the written forms stayed close. Over time the meanings drifted apart in each language, which is why the look-alike English words are not safe guesses.
false_friend_warning: The Ukrainian word with the transliteration 'aktualnyi' looks like the English word 'actual', but it means relevant or current, not real or factual. Students who translate it directly will say something false.
